cone_order: u<=v iff both simple-root coordinates of v-u are nonnegative real numbers
H_convention: sum over antichains A of s^(number of marked simple roots in A)*t^(size of A)
Panyushev: A -> minimal elements of complement of order ideal generated by A
target: Exact cone counterexample plus all minimal strict-order extensions that retain the two simple roots as the only minima and satisfy H=1+2st+(m-2)t+s^2*t^2.
independence_contract: Verifier baseline uses radical arithmetic, exhaustive relation census and ideal maxima before theory code. Theory uses a phi integer ring, reflection BFS, direct antichains and chain permutations. Same-assistant authorship; no independent human/model or kernel review.
